slides.title: Closures & Decorators Overview
slides.prompt: A closure is a inner function that remembers and has access to variables from its enclosing scope even after the outer function has finished executing. Decorators use closures to wrap another function and extend its behavior without modifying it.

slides.title: Decorator Syntactic Sugar

slides.title: Closure Variable Scope
slides.prompt: What keyword is used inside a nested function to modify a variable in the outer non-global scope?

slides.title: Preserving Function Metadata
slides.prompt: Fill in the decorator name from 'functools' used inside wrapper functions to preserve original function name and docstrings.

slides.title: Decorators with Arguments
slides.prompt: How do you pass custom arguments to a decorator itself (e.g., @repeat(num_times=3))?
options: Create an additional outer function layer that accepts arguments and returns the actual decorator function
Pass arguments directly into the wrapper function declaration
Pass arguments via global variables only
slides.correctAnswer: Create an additional outer function layer that accepts arguments and returns the actual decorator function
